title: Israeli army launches operation in Hamas-controlled central Gaza despite ceasefire; residents flee refugee camp
detail: Middle East Eye's live blog reports the Israeli army launched an operation in a Hamas-controlled area of central Gaza despite the October 2025 ceasefire, with the assault targeting residential areas and Palestinians fleeing a refugee camp. The specific camp, scale of the operation and casualty figures are not stated in the feed summary; no IDF statement has been recorded and the report is single-sourced.

media.caption: Israel launches assault targeting residential areas in Gaza despite ceasefire
